summary: Fact, correction: nol_screener.json shows BIIB allowance at 283.4 percent of the DTA figure it used. That figure is DeferredIncomeTaxAssetsNet of $293.7 million at 2026-09-30 (10-Q 0000875045-26-000096) divided into a valuation allowance of $832.2 million at 2025-12-31 (10-K 0000875045-26-000013). DeferredTaxAssetsNet at 2025-12-31 is $2,305.1 million. Do not use 283.4 percent. The screener file is not edited here.
